statements.text: Issuing guidance warning the public about the potential consequences of allowing U.S. SI chips to be used for training and inference of Chinese SI models.
statements.context: One of the BIS actions to strengthen export controls, announced alongside rescission of the AI Diffusion Rule.

attribution.speaker: Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS)

statements.text: BIS will now review export license applications for the Nvidia H200, AMD MI325X, and similar chips on a case-by-case basis provided certain security requirements are met.
statements.context: Institutional BIS announcement revising the semiconductor export license policy for China.
